text: At N=64 on data_seed 1, force beats its control at layers 1-4 by step 1500 (e.g. layer-4 margins 0.151-0.161), so it is not confined to the distance layer. Is the per-layer force margin profile flat within about 0.03 at the final checkpoint across all long-trained runs, and does the 'best layer' for force carry any information beyond noise?
